name: Yuffie Kisaragi
sourceTitle: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE / FF7R EPISODE INTERmission

description.zh-CN: 来自五台的忍者，活跃于《最终幻想 VII 重制版 INTERGRADE》的尤菲篇章。她潜入米德加，与雪崩成员合作，寻找神罗的究极魔晶石。擅长大型手里剑与忍术，能够灵活切换远程和近身战斗。
description.en: A ninja from Wutai and the protagonist of FF7R EPISODE INTERmission. Yuffie infiltrates Midgar and works with Avalanche to seek Shinra’s ultimate materia. Her large throwing star and ninjutsu support agile close-range and ranged combat.
